verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask of a database with a cloud management surface, but the evidence never documents one with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The `cockroach demo` interactive SQL shell and the quickstart sample code are adjacent features, not an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
